Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling demo for FinServPlus

Hi Priya / Ali —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. Quick recap: you're looking to evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency customer-facing models (chat + reranking) across a mix of hosted and private deployment for PCI-adjacent workflows. Key technical asks: SSO/KMS integration, SLA for latency under 150ms p50, and support for streaming replies.

Next step: a 30-minute product demo + technical Q&A where our solutions engineer (Marissa) can walk through architecture and discuss integration patterns. I'm proposing three 30-minute slots next week — please pick one that works for your group or suggest alternatives:

- Tue Apr 6, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed Apr 7, 2026 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT
- Thu Apr 8, 2026 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

I've attached a short datasheet and a draft mutual action plan to help scope the pilot. Marissa (cc) will lead the demo. If any technical stakeholders (CTO/Head of Ops/Platform) are available, please include them so we can cover integration details.

Attachments: redwood-datasheet.pdf (1 page), mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
